title: The First Call | ECHO//100 Episode 88
description: Kavi desperately attempts to rewrite his own origin story while trapped within a fractured memory loop. The fabric of reality tears as past and future collide in the series' inception. Episode 88 of ECHO//100: The Door War. This is an AI-assisted work of original fiction.

scenes.text: Floorboards dissolve into starlight as Kavi reaches toward the trembling hand of his past self.
scenes.caption: Falling through memory
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in red hoodie and glasses reaching downward toward a younger version of himself, floating in an abstract void of starry geometry.

scenes.text: Fingers pass through the younger man like gray smoke, leaving the boy entirely unaware.
scenes.caption: Intangible ghost
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of Kavi's hand passing through the shoulder of a younger Kavi wearing a red hoodie and backpack.

scenes.text: Mira watches from the rafters, her holographic coat flickering under the loop's crushing weight.
scenes.caption: Mira observes
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her glowing teal coat standing on a distorted wooden beam, looking down at Kavi with a concerned expression.

scenes.text: Byte drifts near the ringing telephone, his cyan face pulsing with raw, unfiltered data.
scenes.caption: Byte monitors
scenes.image_prompt: Byte the floating white robot with an orange antenna hovering over a vintage rotary phone emitting static.

scenes.text: The phone screams with an ancient frequency, anchoring this moment to the war's beginning.
scenes.caption: The ringing phone
scenes.image_prompt: A macro shot of a black rotary phone cord twisting into a digital portal, glowing with intense white light.

scenes.text: Mira taps the receiver, forcing a data packet into the line to rewrite history.
scenes.caption: Hacking the past
scenes.image_prompt: Mira's hands glowing with blue light as she interfaces directly with the vintage phone's circuitry.

scenes.text: The ringing stops, replaced by a low hum vibrating through the very core of Kavi.
scenes.caption: The silence shifts
scenes.image_prompt: The younger Kavi freezing mid-reach, the phone dangling off the hook, surrounded by floating digital code.

scenes.text: Past Kavi turns, eyes locking onto the future version standing directly before his gaze.
scenes.caption: The realization
scenes.image_prompt: Young Kavi looking directly into the camera lens with a shocked expression, while older Kavi stares back in terror.
